name: vermil-tasks
description: Vermil: tasks, notes, calendar and a set of optional modules, in one light Windows app

scripts.test:mod: node -e "const a = process.argv.slice(1).map((m) => m.includes('/') || m.endsWith('.js') ? m : `tests/${m}.test.js`); require('node:child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--test', ...(a.length ? a : ['tests/*.test.js'])], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
